card.name: Linking words in epidemiology study descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (using, with, and, the) and a nationality word right after a study design such as cohort or case-control study, or inside a confidence interval. Seen in safety-warning sections describing observational studies.

modes.label: Study design connectors
modes.description: Word like using or with right after a cohort or case-control study, leading into the data source.
modes.example: Two large case-control studies<< using>> separate databases, each with >9,

modes.label: Inside confidence intervals
modes.description: The gap after 95% CI: just before the interval's first number.

modes.label: Linking words in drug class lists
modes.description: Word such as and or Danish in descriptions of trials or registry studies of NSAIDs.
modes.example: In a<< Danish>> National Registry study of patients with heart failure

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens look like unrelated word pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the small connecting words that lead into where a study's data came from or its statistics.
